subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should core add a per-model non-resetting generation deadline, and should that deadline cover only the active model stream or the wider agent attempt including tools and retries?
rationale: Current controls cover outer run duration and provider/stream idleness, but a new public per-model deadline needs an intentional owner, name, precedence order, fallback behavior, and upgrade-safe default.

options.title: Add a model-stream deadline
options.body: Reuse the existing global run timeout as the default and add a per-model override that bounds each selected model's active generation stream without resetting on chunks.

options.title: Use provider timeouts only
options.body: Keep models.providers.<id>.timeoutSeconds as the only model-call control and document that models sharing a provider cannot receive different budgets.

options.title: Prioritize repetition detection
options.body: Decline another timeout knob and address continuously streaming loops through the narrower semantic circuit-breaker work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44965.

recommendation.title: Add a model-stream deadline
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing global run timeout as the default and add a per-model override that bounds each selected model's active generation stream without resetting on chunks.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the existing item-specific design review and have adjacent timeout-policy history on the affected runtime.
